operator_notes.subject: Avatar — Tsaheylu
operator_notes.note: The Tsaheylu connection in Avatar reads as a bicameral lock — paired symmetric authentication — rather than a generalist information-sharing bus. The bicameral architecture (one surface, two chambers) is structurally closer to this than to traditional pub-sub.

operator_notes.subject: Star Wars — protocol droid
operator_notes.note: The protocol-droid metaphor is useful but incomplete. The Autonomaton Protocol aims at egalitarian circuitry — peer cognition rather than translation up to human authority. Same shape, different politics.

operator_notes.subject: Interstellar — substrate-vintage
operator_notes.note: The time-dilation scene encodes the substrate-vintage logic the Registrar will issue against. Cohort year is fixed at issuance; declarations shipped under a 2026 AID stay 2026-vintage regardless of when they ship. Queued for migration into /standards/ canon when issuance functionality goes live.

reserves.declaration: Issuance interface arrives here. Cohort-2026 substrate is live.
